newsitem.title: USA: Wm. Wrigley off on Q3 results - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Wm. Wrigley off on Q3 results - analyst.

text.p: Shares of Wm. Wrigley Jr Co fell 1-1/4 at 58-7/8 after the company reported third quarter earnings that were below expectations, an analyst said.
"The third quarter looks a little short of expectations," said Prudential Securities analyst John McMillin.
But based on the company's special dividend and its policy of paying out half its annual earnings, Wrigley appears on track to report 1996 earnings that are in line with expectations, McMillin added.
Wrigley reported third quarter earnings of $0.56 a share after a charge of $1.0 million for the closure of a plant.
McMillin said the charge, by his calculations, reduced Wrigley's earnings by about one cent.
The third quarter results were below the First Call consensus of $0.55 a share, based on a range of $0.54 to $0.58. Earnings for the quarter were up, however, from the $0.50 it earned a year ago.

Earlier, Wrigley declared an extra dividend of $0.34 a share, bringing its full-year 1996 dividend to $1.02 a share. Since Wrigley's policy is to pay out about 50 percent of its annual earnings, the dividend rate would indicate annual earnings of about $2.04 a share excluding charges.
According to First Call, the mean of analysts' earnings estimates for the year is $2.06, based on a range of $2.02 to $2.10.
